newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil up on at close bullish data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil up on at close bullish data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices surged strongly at close on speculative and technical buying after news of larger falls in Malaysia's November output. Activity was increased due to more demand and inter-month switching. Dec futures was trading at a premium and more covering were seen in futures contracts.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Moved in tandem with futures, with market awaiting November crop data from Ivan Wong on Friday .
